options.text: Adobe dwellings

Earthen mounds
Longhouse structures

rationale.d: Drainage is managed through other systems, not by vigas and latillas.

options.text: Adobe bricks in mud mortar, typically used in arid climates for thermal mass
Corbelled vault stones, which are often seen in ancient stone structures
Wattle and bark lashed to a frame
Rammed earth mounds, a technique involving compacted soil layers
